summary: Frontend-only regression pass of the Payment-outcome + developer-keys dedup refactor. Section A (public /pay/payment-states-demo) passes — Overpay Redirect+Email (navigation to merchant URL with transaction_id&status=success verified via route-abort), Overpay Done Only (Done button, no countdown, Excess row visually bolder/larger 20px/500 vs 16px/400, refund notice, copy toast 'Copied!'), and Underpayment (Partial Payment Received, 59.4% Complete, 15 minutes grace, TXN-2026-DEMO456, 0.0045 ETH / 7.90 GBP, 0.00308 ETH / 5.53 GBP, Pay Remaining with Crypto, Secure badge, mobile 390 no overflow) are all green. Section B (/developer-keys publishable keys) is mostly green: section renders, pk-create-btn, pub_key_id 6 row with LIVE badge/active/pk_live_ value and copy/toggle/edit/revoke/expand all wired, snippet shows publishable-key="pk_live_…" + 'Hide details & snippet', create modal fields + validation (domain required, max<5 disables, submit enables after domain), submit closes modal and shows pk-just-created-banner + Dismiss, edit modal has no env select and prefills, toggle shows 'Publishable key disabled' toast. Section C (buy buttons) CANNOT be tested — buy-buttons-section is NEVER mounted on /developer-keys because of a visibility-flag regression in ApiKeysPage.tsx (BuyButtonsSection is gated on `showDocs` instead of `showKeys`). This is a hard regression against the stated contract. GET /api/buy-buttons never fires. No console errors; SWR does not loop (GET /api/publishable-keys?company_id=1 fires twice, not continuously).

ui_bugs.issue: BuyButtonsSection is wrapped in `{showDocs && …}` instead of `{showKeys && …}` at lines 1858-1869, so on the default Keys tab (view='keys') the entire Buy Buttons section is unmounted — no data-testid=buy-buttons-section, no bb-* testids, no GET /api/buy-buttons?company_id=1, no bb-create-btn / bb-list / rows / expand / snippet / modal / reactivate. Regression caused by the dedup refactor — should render alongside PublishableKeysSection on the Keys tab.

Typing 'usdt-trc20' and pressing Enter / Comma / Space / Tab does NOT create a 'USDT-TRC20' chip inside the create-key modal (currencies area innerText is just a zero-width space). The spec requires an uppercased chip to appear. Could be a chip-trigger regression in primitives.tsx TokenChips (keybinding or onBlur handler) — PublishableKeysSection domain chips work fine with same approach, so TokenChips may be inconsistent for currencies, or currencies is wired to a different committing key than domains. Impact: user has no way to add a currency restriction through the UI.

Confirm dialog opened by pk-revoke-6 does NOT expose data-testids for its Cancel / Delete buttons. Cancel click via get_by_role did not close the dialog on first try (needed a second attempt). Not a hard bug, but testability is below the rest of the refactor — recommend adding `data-testid="pk-revoke-cancel"` / `pk-revoke-confirm` (and the equivalent for bb) in keyedResource/useKeyedResource so Playwright scripts can target them reliably.

rca of the issue: ApiKeysPage.tsx renders feature sections conditionally by `view`. `showKeys = view==='all'||view==='keys'` and `showDocs = view==='all'||view==='docs'`. In the pre-refactor code both PublishableKeysSection and BuyButtonsSection lived under the Keys tab (showKeys). After the dedup merge the BuyButtonsSection wrapper at lines 1858-1869 was placed under `{showDocs && …}` — on the default landing tab (Keys) `showDocs` is false, so the section tree never mounts, no SWR fetch is triggered for /api/buy-buttons?company_id=1, and none of the bb-* testids exist. Reproduction: open /developer-keys as merchant 1 → scroll to bottom → observe PublishableKeysSection card ending the Keys tab with no Buy buttons card below it; then click the Docs tab and the Buy buttons card appears where it does not belong. Mitigation: change the condition at line 1858 to `{showKeys && (` (and verify it's still inside the Keys-tab Box group, not the Docs-tab group).
